candidate_query:
MATCH (m:Meeting)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m)
WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (r)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '6.6.3'}) }
WITH m, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionCount
RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingOrdinal, resolutionCount
ORDER BY meetingOrdinal ASC

MATCH (m:Meeting)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m)
WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (r)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '6.6.3'}) }
RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingOrdinal,
       collect(DISTINCT r.resolutionId) AS resolutionIds
ORDER BY meetingOrdinal ASC
